name: Detstvo
summary: Relive the last day of school before summer break in a nostalgic Soviet neighborhood. Wander through faded apartment buildings, dusty playgrounds, and forbidden construction sites, playing hide-and-seek with friends, scoring goals, watching cartoons, and rediscovering old games on an ancient phone. The world comes alive through period details, dynamic lighting, and an atmospheric soundtrack capturing everyday sounds—a neighbor's guitar, a tape recorder, the kitchen radio. This quiet experience asks you to simply be present in a day you'll always remember but can never return to.
